source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 2 (PDF 36-50), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Bacteria and Viruses) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Name the five kingdoms of Whittaker. Which kingdom includes prokaryotes?
(Whittaker ki paanch kingdoms ke naam likhein. Prokaryotes kis kingdom mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Robert H. Whittaker ki paanch kingdoms: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Monera mein prokaryotes hain; baqi chaar mein eukaryotes.

book_ref.quote: The first one includes prokaryotes and the other four include eukaryotes

blocks.prompt:
2 Why do most biologists favour the three-domain system over the five-kingdom system?
(Zyada tar biologists five-kingdom ke bajaye three-domain system kyun pasand karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pichhle das saal mein molecular studies ne five-kingdom system ki sangeen khamiyan dikhayin. Three-domain system molecular data se zyada milta hai; is mein bacteria ki apni domain, domain Bacteria, hai.

book_ref.quote: It is more aligned with the data gained from molecular studies

blocks.prompt:
3 Write the general features of the cellular organization of bacteria.
(Bacteria ki cellular banawat ki aam khususiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria mukhtalif qisam ka group hain, sab ki banawat unicellular prokaryotic hai. In mein membrane wale organelles, wazeh nucleus samet, nahi hote aur in ki cellular banawat sab se saada hai.

book_ref.quote: They have the simplest cellular organization

blocks.prompt:
4 What is the basis of Gram's staining? Who devised it?
(Gram's staining ki bunyad kya hai? Ise kis ne banaya?)
blocks.explanation: Ise Sir Hans Christian Gram ne banaya. Gram-positive bacteria violet dye rok kar purple ho jate hain; Gram-negative dye nahi rokte aur apne asli rang mein dikhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Gram-negative bacteria do not retain violet dye and so they appear in original colour

blocks.prompt:
5 Give reason: Gram-negative bacteria are resistant to many antibiotics.
(Wajah batayein: Gram-negative bacteria bohat si antibiotics ke khilaf mazahmat rakhte hain.)
blocks.explanation: In ki cell wall mein lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins ki outer membrane hoti hai. Yehi outer membrane Gram-negative bacteria ko bohat si antibiotics se bachati hai.

book_ref.quote: The outer membrane makes Gram-negative bacteria resistant to many antibiotics

blocks.prompt:
6 What is porin? What is periplasmic space?
(Porin kya hai? Periplasmic space kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Porin Gram-negative ki outer membrane ka protein hai jo khaas molecules ke liye surakh ka kaam karta hai. Periplasmic space peptidoglycan tah aur cell membrane ke darmiyan ki jagah hai; Gram-negative mein yeh Gram-positive se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: The cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria has more periplasmic space

blocks.prompt:
7 Where is the bacterial cell membrane present? How is its chemical makeup different?
(Bacterial cell membrane kahan hoti hai? Is ki chemical banawat kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell membrane cell wall ke bilkul neeche hoti hai; jin bacteria mein cell wall nahi (mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas) un mein yahi sab se bahar ki tah hai. Is ki banawat mein cholesterol jaise sterols nahi hote.

book_ref.quote: Cell membrane or plasma membrane is present just beneath cell wall

blocks.prompt:
8 What does bacterial cytoplasm contain and what does it lack?
(Bacterial cytoplasm mein kya hota hai aur kya nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein hal shuda cheezen aur bare structures jaise nucleoid, ribosomes aur mesosomes hain. Is mein cytoskeleton aur membrane wale organelles nahi.

book_ref.quote: Cytoplasm contains dissolved substances and large structures such as nucleoid, ribosomes, and mesosomes

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the ribosomes of bacteria.
(Bacteria ke ribosomes bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se ribosomes cytoplasm mein azad bikhre hain aur kuch plasma membrane se dheele jure hain. Yeh eukaryotic ribosomes se chhote hain; har aik 70S hai, bari subunit 50S aur chhoti 30S.

book_ref.quote: Bacterial ribosomes are smaller than eukaryotic ribosomes

blocks.prompt:
10 What is the nucleoid? Describe the DNA it contains.
(Nucleoid kya hai? Is mein maujood DNA bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nucleoid cytoplasm ke beech ke qareeb be-tarteeb ghana hissa hai jis mein DNA hota hai. Bacterium mein aik, gol, double stranded DNA hota hai jis ke saath histones nahi hote; ise kabhi bacterium ka chromosome kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: A bacterium possesses a single, circular, double stranded DNA

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between the bacterial chromosome and a plasmid.
(Bacterial chromosome aur plasmid mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono gol double-stranded DNA hain; in ki jagah, tadaad aur kaam mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: It is sometimes called the chromosome of bacterium

rows: Chromosome se bahar ka DNA, kuch bacteria mein.
Gol, double stranded, taqseem se pehle ya baad khud copy hota hai.
Na-munasib halaat (maslan antibiotics) ke khilaf mazahmat ki genes.

blocks.prompt:
12 What are endospores? Write their two characteristics.
(Endospores kya hain? In ki do khususiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Endospores khaas aaram karne wale cells hain jo bohat se bacteria lambe sakht halaat se bachne ke liye banate hain. Yeh moti wall wale aur metabolically ghair-faal (dormant) hain.

book_ref.quote: Many bacteria can survive extended periods of harsh conditions by forming specialized

blocks.prompt:
13 How does the new DNA come to be surrounded by two membranes during sporulation?
(Sporulation mein naya DNA do membranes se kaise ghir jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA replication ke baad cell membrane septum bana kar naye DNA aur thore cytoplasm ko alag karti hai. Phir membrane dobara naye DNA, cytoplasm aur septum ke gird barhti hai, is liye naya DNA do membranes se ghir jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Cell membrane again grows around the new DNA, cytoplasm, and septum

blocks.prompt:
14 What happens to the vegetative cell at the end of sporulation?
(Sporulation ke aakhir mein vegetative cell ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka DNA toot jata hai aur poora cell paani kho deta hai. Peptidoglycan tah aur spore coat banne aur endospore pakne ke baad vegetative cell toot jata hai aur endospore bahar aa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The structure matures into endospore

blocks.prompt:
15 How does a flagellum move a bacterium forward?
(Flagellum bacterium ko aage kaise le jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Flagella ki harkat bacteria ko maye (liquid) mein chalne deti hai. Flagellum ka counter clockwise ghoomna cell ko aage dhakelta hai aur flagellum peeche rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Flagellar movement allows bacteria to travel in liquid media

blocks.prompt:
16 Differentiate between gliding and sliding movements of bacteria.
(Bacteria ki gliding aur sliding movement mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono flagella ke baghair satah par harkatein hain; in ki wajah mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: Sliding: It is due to the expansion created by the pushing force of dividing cells

rows: Taqseem hote cells ke dhakke se paida phailao.
Slime sakht satah par asani se phisalne deti hai; yeh twitching jaisi hai.
Quwwat khud taqseem hote cells se aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 What is Brownian movement in bacteria? Give an example.
(Bacteria mein Brownian movement kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Kuch bacteria jin mein na flagella hain na pili, maye ke zarraat ki be-tarteeb aur be-qaboo harkat se hilte hain. Misaal: Streptococcus.

book_ref.quote: move due to the random and uncontrolled movements of the particles present in fluid

blocks.prompt:
18 Name the bacteria on the basis of number and position of flagella.
(Flagella ki tadaad aur jagah ki bunyad par bacteria ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Atrichous: koi flagellum nahi. Monotrichous: aik polar flagellum. Lophotrichous: aik qutb par flagella ka guchha. Amphitrichous: dono qutbon par flagella. Peritrichous: poore cell ke gird flagella.

book_ref.quote: The secondary function of flagella is to detect and respond to chemical signals

blocks.prompt:
19 Differentiate between lophotrichous and amphitrichous bacteria.
(Lophotrichous aur amphitrichous bacteria mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein qutbi flagella hain; in ki jagah mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: The bacteria with a tuft of flagella at one pole are called lophotrichous

rows: Aik qutb par flagella ka guchha.
Cell ke sirf aik sire par flagella.
Cell ke dono siron par flagella.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 2.7 mein in dono ki tasveerein aapas mein badal gayi hain. Text ke mutabiq sahi: lophotrichous = aik qutb par guchha, amphitrichous = dono qutbon par.

blocks.prompt:
20 Differentiate between the flagellum of bacteria and of eukaryotes.
(Bacteria aur eukaryotes ke flagellum mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono harkat mein madad dete hain magar in ki banawat bilkul mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: The flagellum of bacteria is entirely different in structure from the flagellum of eukaryotes

blocks.prompt:
21 What is the basal body of a bacterial flagellum? How does it differ in Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria?
(Bacterial flagellum ki basal body kya hai? Gram-positive aur Gram-negative mein yeh kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Basal body cell membrane ke bilkul neeche hoti hai aur ghoomne wale rings par mushtamil hai jo flagellum ko cell membrane aur cell wall mein jamate hain. Gram-positive mein rings ka aik jora aur Gram-negative mein do jore hain.

book_ref.quote: The rings anchor the flagellum in cell membrane and cell wall

blocks.prompt:
22 Where are bacteria found? What does the fossil record tell about prokaryotes?
(Bacteria kahan paye jate hain? Fossil record prokaryotes ke baare mein kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria paani, hawa, mitti, khane aur jaanwaron aur paudon ke jismon mein milte hain; yeh tamam eukaryotes se zyada hain aur shadeed mahol mein bhi zinda rehte hain. Fossils batate hain ke prokaryotes 3.5 billion saal pehle kasrat se thay aur agle 2 billion saal zameen par akele rahe.

book_ref.quote: Today, prokaryotes (archaea and bacteria) are found wherever there is life

blocks.prompt:
23 Who classified prokaryotes into 16 phyla? Name any four groups of the domain Bacteria.
(Prokaryotes ko 16 phyla mein kis ne taqseem kiya? Domain Bacteria ke koi chaar groups ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Margulis aur Schwartz ne tamam prokaryotes ko 16 phyla mein taqseem kiya. Bacteria ke ahem groups: omnibacteria, cyanobacteria, mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas, spirochaetes, pseudomonads, actinomycetes, nitrogen-fixing aerobic bacteria aur chemosynthetic bacteria.

book_ref.quote: Margulis and Schwartz proposed a useful classification system for all prokaryotes

blocks.prompt:
24 Write four characteristics of omnibacteria with an example.
(Omnibacteria ki chaar khususiyat misaal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Omnibacteria sakht, rod numa, heterotrophic, Gram-negative bacteria hain jin mein bohat se ahem pathogens hain. Zyada tar flagella wale, spores nahi banate aur aam tor par aerobic hain. Misaal: Escherichia coli (vibrios bhi shamil).

book_ref.quote: Many important pathogens are included in this group

blocks.prompt:
25 What are heterocysts? Where are cyanobacteria commonly found?
(Heterocysts kya hain? Cyanobacteria aam tor par kahan milte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Heterocysts bohat se cyanobacteria ke khaas cells hain jin mein yeh hawa ki nitrogen fix karte hain. Cyanobacteria mitti mein mats ki shakal mein, chatanon par lichens mein aur samandar ki tah ke mats mein zyada milte hain.

book_ref.quote: Cyanobacteria-containing lichens are found on rock surfaces

blocks.prompt:
26 Why do colourful blooms appear in polluted water?
(Ganday paani mein rangeen blooms kyun nazar aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ganday paani mein cyanobacteria ki tez growth se rangeen blooms bante hain. Rang in ke photosynthetic pigments se hain: chlorophyll-a, carotenoids aur neele aur laal phycobilins.

book_ref.quote: The colours of such blooms result from the photosynthetic pigments of cyanobacteria

blocks.prompt:
27 Give reason: penicillin does not affect mycoplasmas. Name one disease each caused by mycoplasmas and spiroplasmas.
(Wajah batayein: penicillin mycoplasmas par asar nahi karti. Mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas ki aik aik bimari ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas mein cell wall nahi, is liye penicillin aur cell wall rokne wali antibiotics in par asar nahi karti. Kuch mycoplasmas insanon mein kuch qisam ka pneumonia karte hain; spiroplasmas nariyal ki lethal yellowing karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These groups differ from all other bacteria in that they lack cell walls

blocks.prompt:
28 Write the characteristics and importance of pseudomonads.
(Pseudomonads ki khususiyat aur ahmiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pseudomonads seedhe ya mure Gram-negative rods hain jin ke aik sire par aik ya kayi flagella, mitti aur paani mein milte hain. Yeh organic compounds asani se torte hain; kuch autotrophic, bohat se paudon ke pathogens aur kuch denitrification karte hain. Pseudomonas aeruginosa kamzor logon ko infect kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: They can easily break down organic compounds

blocks.prompt:
29 Name two diseases caused by actinomycetes and four antibiotics obtained from them.
(Actinomycetes se hone wali do bimariyan aur un se milne wali chaar antibiotics ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mycobacterium leprae leprosy aur Mycobacterium tuberculosis TB karta hai (kuch actinomycetes dental plaque bhi karte hain). Actinomycetes se asal mein hasil antibiotics: tetracycline, chloramphenicol, erythromycin aur neomycin.

book_ref.quote: Another member i.e., Mycobacterium tuberculosis is the cause of tuberculosis

blocks.prompt:
30 What is Azotobacter? What does it do with atmospheric nitrogen?
(Azotobacter kya hai? Yeh hawa ki nitrogen ke saath kya karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Azotobacter nitrogen-fixing aerobic, Gram-negative bacterium hai jo mitti aur paani mein milta hai. Yeh hawa ki nitrogen ko ammonia (NH₃) mein fix karta hai; phir nitrifying bacteria (Nitrosomonas, Nitrobacter) ammonia ko nitrite aur nitrate banate hain.

book_ref.quote: It is found in soil and water and converts atmospheric nitrogen into nitrates

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke Azotobacter nitrogen ko nitrates mein badalta hai; yeh ghalat hai. Azotobacter ammonia banata hai, nitrate nahi. Nitrate nitrifying bacteria banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
31 What are chemosynthetic bacteria? Give two examples and their role.
(Chemosynthetic bacteria kya hain? Do misalein aur un ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chemosynthetic bacteria nitrogen, sulphur aur iron ke inorganic compounds ko oxidize kar ke energy lete aur khana banate hain. Misalein: Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter jo NH₃ ko oxidize karte hain; yeh nitrite aur nitrate banti hai, is liye nitrogen cycle mein in ka ahem kirdar hai.

book_ref.quote: They use this energy for the synthesis of their food

blocks.prompt:
32 Give reason: bacteria are called recyclers of nature.
(Wajah batayein: bacteria ko qudrat ke recyclers kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria taqreeban tamam biogeochemical cycles mein shamil hain jin mein zaroori elements organisms aur mahol ke darmiyan aate jate hain. Nitrifying aur denitrifying bacteria nitrogen cycle poora karte, decomposers carbon-hydrogen-oxygen cycle chalate aur cyanobacteria azad oxygen barhate hain.

book_ref.quote: Bacteria are involved in almost all biogeochemical cycles

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between nitrifying and denitrifying bacteria with examples.
(Nitrifying aur denitrifying bacteria mein misalon ke saath farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono nitrogen cycle mukammal karne mein hissa lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Nitrifying bacteria (Nitrosomonas, Nitrobacter and Azotobacter)

rows: NH₃ ko oxidize karte hain jo nitrite aur nitrate banti hai.
Chemosynthetic: nitrogen compounds ki oxidation se energy.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ne Azotobacter ko bhi nitrifying likha hai; yeh ghalat hai. Azotobacter nitrogen-fixing bacterium hai jo hawa ki nitrogen se ammonia banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
34 Name any four fermented foods prepared with the help of bacteria. Which bacterium is used?
(Bacteria ki madad se banne wali koi chaar khameeri ghizaon ke naam likhein. Kaun sa bacterium istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lactobacillus yeasts aur molds ke saath hazaron saal se cheese, achaar, soy sauce, sirka, wine aur dahi jaisi khameeri ghizayen banane mein istemal ho raha hai.

book_ref.quote: have been used for thousands of years in the preparation of fermented foods

blocks.prompt:
35 What is bioremediation? Give two examples.
(Bioremediation kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Bioremediation un bacteria se mahol ki aloodgi khatam karna hai jo organic compounds asani se torte hain. Misalein: shehar ke sewage ko be-zarar cheezon mein badalna aur petroleum ke hydrocarbons khane wale bacteria se tel ka phailao saaf karna (aur sanati zehreela kachra).

book_ref.quote: For example, bacteria are used to decompose city sewage into harmless products

blocks.prompt:
36 What are biopesticides? Name the bacterium commonly used.
(Biopesticides kya hain? Aam istemal hone wale bacterium ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Biopesticides woh bacteria hain jo biological pest control mein pesticides ki jagah istemal hote hain, aam tor par Bacillus thuringiensis, Gram-positive mitti ka bacterium. Yeh mahol dost hain aur insanon, jangli hayat, pollinators aur zyada tar faida mand keeron par kam ya koi asar nahi.

book_ref.quote: a Gram-positive, soil dwelling bacterium

blocks.prompt:
37 Give reason: bacteria are widely used in molecular biology, genetics and biochemistry.
(Wajah batayein: bacteria molecular biology, genetics aur biochemistry mein bohat istemal hote hain.)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria tezi se barhte hain aur scientists inhein asani se badal sakte hain. Is liye bacterial DNA mein mutations kar ke genes aur enzymes ke kaam maloom kiye jate hain aur insani genes dal kar ilaaji proteins banaye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Bacteria can grow quickly and scientists can manipulate with them very easily

blocks.prompt:
38 Which tissues of a healthy animal carry normal flora and which are free of microbes?
(Sehatmand jaanwar ke kaun se tissues par normal flora hota hai aur kaun se jaraseem se khali hain?)
blocks.explanation: Andar ke tissues jaise khoon, dimagh aur muscle aam tor par microorganisms se khali hain. Satah ke tissues jaise jild aur mucous membranes mahol se musalsal milte hain aur un par kuch microbes baste hain, yani normal flora.

book_ref.quote: On the other hand, the surface tissues, e.g., skin and mucous membranes

blocks.prompt:
39 What does the normal flora of humans consist of?
(Insanon ka normal flora kin cheezon par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bacteria, kuch fungi aur protists, aur kuch methanogenic archaea par mushtamil hai. Bacteria sab se zyada aur numayan hain.

book_ref.quote: The normal flora of humans consists of bacteria, a few fungi and protists, and some methanogenic archaea

blocks.prompt:
40 Why is the association of humans with normal flora called mutualistic?
(Insanon aur normal flora ke taalluq ko mutualistic kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono ko faida hai. Normal flora ko insani jism mein ghiza, mustahkam mahol, yaksaan temperature, hifazat aur transport milte hain, aur jism ko vitamins, pathogens se hifazat aur cross-reactive antibodies milte hain.

book_ref.quote: In human body, normal flora gets nutrients, a stable environment and constant temperature, protection, and transport

blocks.prompt:
41 How does normal flora supply vitamins to the human body?
(Normal flora insani jism ko vitamins kaise deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ghiza ki naali ke bacteria vitamins banate aur apni zaroorat se zyada kharij karte hain; yeh jazb ho kar jism mein phailte hain. Enteric bacteria vitamin K aur B₁₂ aur lactic acid bacteria kuch B-vitamins banate hain.

book_ref.quote: They excrete vitamins which are in excess of their needs

blocks.prompt:
42 How small are viruses? How can they be seen?
(Viruses kitne chhote hain? Inhein kaise dekha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Viruses 20 nm (parvovirus) se 250 nm (pox viruses) tak hain aur zyada tar bacteria se 10 se 1000 guna chhote hain. Yeh bohat chhote infection karne wale agents hain jo sirf electron microscope se nazar aate hain.

book_ref.quote: Viruses are extremely small infectious agents and can only be seen under electron microscope

blocks.prompt:
43 What are capsid and capsomeres? Give the capsomere number of one virus.
(Capsid aur capsomeres kya hain? Kisi aik virus ke capsomeres ki tadaad batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Capsid virus ke core ke gird protein ka khol hai jo virus ko khaas shakal deta hai. Yeh protein subunits capsomeres se bana hai jin ki tadaad aur qisam har virus ki pehchan hai, maslan herpes virus 162, adenovirus 252.

book_ref.quote: The number and kind of capsomeres is characteristic of a particular virus

blocks.prompt:
44 Differentiate between enveloped and naked viruses.
(Enveloped aur naked viruses mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein nucleocapsid hai; farq bahar ki membrane ka hai.

book_ref.quote: In some animal viruses only, nucleocapsid is covered by another membrane called envelope

rows: Envelope host cell se aai lipid wali membrane hai.
Capsid sab se bahar ka khol hai.
Sirf kuch animal viruses mein, maslan HIV.

blocks.prompt:
45 Describe the diversity in the shapes of viruses.
(Viruses ki shakalon mein tanawwo bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Animal aur plant viruses polyhedron (kayi rukh) ya helical ho sakte hain. Bacteriophages cubical, icosahedral (20 rukh), helical ya complex (polyhedral sar aur rod numa dum) ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: The animal and plant viruses may be polyhedron (having many sides) or helical

blocks.prompt:
46 What are bacteriophages? What is the role of the tail fibres of T4 phage?
(Bacteriophages kya hain? T4 phage ke tail fibres ka kya kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteriophages viruses ka mukhtalif group hain jo bacteria par hamla karte hain aur sab se pecheeda viruses mein se hain; E. coli ke T-phages sab se mashhoor hain. T4 mein end plate se jure chhe tail fibres phage ko bacterial wall se chipakne mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Bacteriophages are a diverse group of viruses that attack bacteria

blocks.prompt:
47 What are transgenic bacteria? How do bacteriophages help produce them?
(Transgenic bacteria kya hain? Bacteriophages inhein banane mein kaise madad karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Transgenic bacteria ke genome mein kisi doosre organism ka DNA hota hai. Matlooba gene phage ke DNA mein dala jata hai; phage use bacterium tak le jata hai aur jab is ka DNA bacterial chromosome se milta hai to gene bacterial DNA ka hissa ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The gene of interest is inserted into the DNA of bacteriophage

blocks.prompt:
48 What are retroviruses? What is their most distinguishing character?
(Retroviruses kya hain? In ki sab se numayan khususiyat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Retroviruses animal viruses ka khaas group hain, maslan HIV, jin mein RNA aur capsid hota hai aur in ke gird glycoprotein spikes wala lipid envelope. In ki sab se numayan khususiyat enzyme reverse transcriptase hai jo single stranded RNA se DNA banata hai.

book_ref.quote: The most distinguishing character of retroviruses is the presence of a specific enzyme, reverse transcriptase

blocks.prompt:
49 Write the history of the discovery of AIDS and HIV.
(AIDS aur HIV ki daryaft ki tareekh likhein.)
blocks.explanation: AIDS pehli dafa 1981 mein report hui; baad mein un mareezon mein bhi mili jinhein AIDS mareezon ka khoon ya khoon ki cheezen lagi thin. 1984 mein pata chala ke AIDS ka sabab virus hai aur 1986 mein ise Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) naam diya gaya.

book_ref.quote: Later on, AIDS was discovered in non-homosexual patients too who had received blood or blood products

blocks.prompt:
50 Why are viruses considered different from the five kingdoms of living organisms?
(Viruses ko zinda organisms ki paanch kingdoms se mukhtalif kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Viruses mein cellular banawat nahi magar yeh zinda cheezon ki kuch khususiyat dikhate hain. Is liye inhein cells wali paanch kingdoms mein nahi rakha jata.

book_ref.quote: Viruses are the representatives of such organisms
